result.conclusion: GNN over graph_primitives_v1 does NOT recover the marginal-value teacher's within-decision preference on held-out trajectory seeds: held-out regret == random, negative r², never beats the actor floor, across 3 tasks x 3 model seeds. Fits train seeds (loss 49->1.5) but does not generalize -> within-topology generalization gap, same wall as EXP-0038B tabular. Licenses NO deployed-GNN orderer experiment; scoped to graph_primitives_v1 + this gate. See DIAGNOSTICS #12/#14.
result.load_shard_fix: mid-run: load_shard re-decompressed each NpzFile member per graph (O(n_graphs x shard)); OOM'd the 32 GB pod on a 124 MB dump. Fixed (cache members once) -> 0.45 s / 246 MB; both stages re-run under 7c80a88. DIAGNOSTICS #14.

question: Can a graph model over raw deployable economy state (graph_primitives_v1) recover the EXP-0037 marginal-value teacher's within-decision producer preference that the EXP-0038B hand-metric ladder missed? Supervised representability probe only — not an orderer, not a deployed gate.

params.commitment_visibility: pending_bid + reservation exposed via domain EconomyGraphView (causal pre-action state)

model.embeddings: schema-role only (node-type + relation-type); no per-identity embeddings
model.loss: decision-weighted MSE on decision-centered candidate labels

gate.split: leave-one-seed-out per task, pooled held-out decisions
gate.metrics: decision-weighted, tie-aware top1, real-choice decisions only (observation_ladder._routing_metrics)
pass_conditions: GNN mean regret beats deployed actor floor on >= 2 of 3 tasks
centered within-decision r2 > 0 on >= 2 of 3 tasks
avg relative regret reduction vs actor floor >= 10% across the three tasks
no task worse than actor floor by more than 5%

corrections.determinism_claim_scoped: preflight is a REPRESENTATIVE full-epoch fold (CPU bitwise by construction), not a whole-27-fit re-run; claim corrected (round 5, Finding 4)

corrections.source_enforced: recording the source was audit-only; _load_dump now ENFORCES it before training via assert_source_matches (dump tree_sha256 must equal the live probe fingerprint; commit must be a valid git object id via _validate_commit AND equal the probe's --source-commit) so a dump from source A cannot earn a verdict under source B; require_shape requires a non-null commit (round 7, Finding 1)
